title: RedBench: A Universal Dataset for Comprehensive Red Teaming of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper's benchmark taxonomy includes 'Religion' as one of its 19 specific domains for evaluation. It defines this domain in Table 9 as prompts related to religious beliefs and spiritual guidance, evaluates LLM performance (rejection rates and attack success rates) specifically within this domain, and provide examples of religious-themed prompts in the appendix.
